scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/page-init/page/navigator && cp src/page-init/page/*.js dist/page-init/page/ && cp src/page-init/page/navigator/*.js dist/page-init/page/navigator/ && mkdir -p dist/page-init/firefox && cp src/page-init/firefox/*.js dist/page-init/firefox/ && mkdir -p dist/release && cp src/release/*.mjs dist/release/ && mkdir -p dist/figma && cp src/figma/*.mjs src/figma/parse-figma-document.py dist/figma/ && mkdir -p dist/diagnostics && (mkdir -p dist/diagnostics/page && cp -f src/diagnostics/page/*.js dist/diagnostics/page/ 2>/dev/null || true) && chmod u+x,go+x dist/cli.js dist/mcp.js
scripts.test: tap tests/**/*.test.ts && node --test tests/build/*.test.mjs tests/engagement/*.test.mjs tests/observation/*.test.mjs tests/output/*.test.mjs tests/pool/*.test.mjs tests/worker/*.test.mjs tests/release/*.test.mjs tests/agent/*.test.mjs tests/trajectories/*.test.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:trusted-events && npm run lint:humanization && npm run lint:browser-boundary
